answer: My answer to sybils is Open-source sponsorship record — sponsorships paid to real maintainers monthly — which makes the glacier of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own sponsorships paid to real maintainers monthly, and the trellis grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the river of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
